body:
CORRECTION TO NEW CUSTODY FINDING: the thirteen modified paths and standalone temp checkout were NOT newly discovered at 22:13. This same actor had already recorded them on the bead at 19:27, 19:45, and 20:09. I failed to consult that earlier note before describing the custody fact as new.

WHAT IS NEW AND SURVIVES: the owner supplied the live URL, and I proved that Python PID 41564 at port 8765 is serving that exact dirty checkout; the current served HTML and full dirty diff hashes are now measured; and the owner specifically judged this uncommitted version better but still extremely thin. The do-not-clean warning remains valid, but custody itself was already known and repeatedly recorded. I am correcting attribution and novelty, not retracting the URL-to-checkout evidence.
